entities.name: Adolf Hitler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: German dictator (1889–1945) who led the Nazi Party to power, initiated World War II, and orchestrated the Holocaust — the systematic murder of six million Jews and millions of others. His regime represents the nadir of 20th-century totalitarianism.
